νηάς.m: gigantic, mythological animal from Samos called Neades in English, inspired by the fossilized remains of extinct proboscideans

n: a male patronymic meaning “son of Νηλεύς (Nēleús) [=Neleus]”

νηοπόλος.m: busying oneself in a temple: a temple-keeper

νηπιάχω.m: to be childish, play like a child

νηπίεος.m: not yet speaking; like a child, childish, silly
